partners.diseaseBName: neurodevelopmental disorder with microcephaly, hypotonia, and absent language
partners.mechanism_chain: Variant in CLEC7A (HGVS:some_variant_A) —DISRUPTS→ CLEC7A (HGNC:25896); CLEC7A (HGNC:25896) —DISRUPTS→ Innate immune response (GO:0006955); Innate immune response (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Inflammatory response (HP:00114200); Variant in PSMB1 (HGVS:some_variant_B) —DISRUPTS→ PSMB1 (HGNC:9548); PSMB1 (HGNC:9548) —DISRUPTS→ Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0006508); Proteasome-mediated protein degradation (GO:0006508) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental delay (HP:0001263).
